instruction: Apply a Fade transition effect to all slides in the open presentation.

command: import pyautogui; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); import time; time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully disabled Presenter Console by navigating Tools > Options > LibreOffice Impress > General and unchecking 'Enable Presenter Console', then clicking Apply.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice menus, open Tools > Options dialog, navigate settings tree, toggle checkboxes, apply changes, interact with Slide Show settings
metadata.task_rationale: Tests presentation modification capability (transitions) instead of just settings changes. Agent showed ability to navigate Impress menus including Slide Show menu. Applying transitions requires selecting all slides and using the Slide menu or transitions panel.
metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a Fade transition to all 23 slides. Evaluator downloads the saved PPTX and checks each slide's transition element via python-pptx. Returns partial credit proportional to slides with correct transition.

scoring_breakdown.per_slide: Each slide with correct Fade transition contributes 1/23 to score

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts transition type from each slide's p:transition XML element by parsing the first child tag name (e.g., <p:fade> -> 'fade'), which matches OOXML's representation of Fade transitions.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter as a direct rules dict (expected.get('transition_type', 'fade')), consistent with the framework's get_rule behavior.
Complete coverage: instruction requires Fade on ALL slides, and the evaluator checks every slide individually with proportional partial credit (correct/total).
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S with Enter to confirm format dialog) before getter reads the PPTX, ensuring fresh state.
Edge cases handled: missing transition elements return None (not counted as correct), zero slides returns 0.0, error results return 0.0.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: LibreOffice may use a slightly different transition name mapping when saving to PPTX. If the Fade transition maps to a variant tag name (e.g., 'dissolve' instead of 'fade' in some LibreOffice versions), the comparison would fail. Consider testing with the actual LibreOffice PPTX output to confirm the tag name.
